uk-loneliness-minister.name: UK minister for loneliness
uk-loneliness-minister.outcome: Tracey Crouch named first minister for loneliness after the Jo Cox Commission, which was set up by former Member of Parliament Jo Cox before she was murdered and had called for a minister; more than 9 million people in the UK said they always or often feel lonely
uk-loneliness-minister.limits: News report on the appointment, not on results; the role has changed hands and been folded into other portfolios since.
uk-loneliness-minister.locator: "called for a minister to be appointed to spearhead the government's strategy"

uk-loneliness-strategy.name: England's first loneliness strategy
uk-loneliness-strategy.outcome: Committed that all family doctors in England could refer lonely patients to community activities by 2023; Royal Mail pilot had postal workers check on lonely people; first Employer Pledge on loneliness in the workplace, with employers including Sainsbury's, Transport for London and the Co-op pledging further action on employees' social wellbeing; £1.8m to increase community spaces, turning underused areas into community cafés, art spaces or gardens
uk-loneliness-strategy.limits: Government press release announcing plans; it does not report outcomes. The postal pilot covered three towns, and the pledge and space funding were commitments, not results.
uk-loneliness-strategy.locator: "postal workers check up on lonely people as part of their usual delivery rounds"

england-social-prescribing.name: Social prescribing in England's health service
england-social-prescribing.outcome: More than 3,300 link workers employed; the 2019 goal was 900,000 referrals by 2023-24 and was exceeded
england-social-prescribing.limits: News summary of a Lancet Public Health study; referral counts are estimates, and referral does not show that loneliness eased. Rare in the US.

japan-loneliness-minister.name: Japan's minister for loneliness and isolation
japan-loneliness-minister.outcome: Tetsushi Sakamoto appointed in February 2021 after suicides rose for the first time in 11 years
japan-loneliness-minister.limits: Appointment coverage; no specific measures had been announced when the article ran.
japan-loneliness-minister.locator: "the minister in charge of dealing with problems of isolation and loneliness"

seoul-loneliness-line.name: Seoul's Goodbye Loneliness 120 helpline
seoul-loneliness-line.outcome: Opened April 1, 2025, reached by calling 02-120 and pressing 5 after the voice prompt; 3,088 consultations in about six weeks against a full-year target of 3,000; 59% of callers middle-aged
seoul-loneliness-line.limits: Early call counts from one city; counts do not show whether callers felt less lonely.
seoul-loneliness-line.locator: Headline: "surpasses annual goal in just six weeks"

jumbo-chat-checkout.name: Jumbo supermarket chat checkouts
jumbo-chat-checkout.outcome: First slow 'chat checkout' opened in 2019; about 200 planned, plus 200 more within a year, as part of a health ministry program
jumbo-chat-checkout.limits: Rollout news; no measured effect on loneliness was reported.
jumbo-chat-checkout.locator: First Kletskassa opened in 2019 in Vlijmen, Brabant

humanitas-students.name: Humanitas students living in a retirement home
humanitas-students.outcome: Six university students live free in a home for older people in exchange for 30 hours a month with residents; one student described teaching computer skills, cooking with residents and sometimes just talking
humanitas-students.limits: One home with six students, reported in 2015; current terms not confirmed.
humanitas-students.locator: "30 hours a month in the home"

mens-sheds.name: Men's Sheds movement
mens-sheds.outcome: About 900 sheds worldwide; started in Australia in the mid-1990s to address isolation among older men
mens-sheds.limits: Feature story; the US had only a dozen or so groups in 2019, so many towns have none.

us-mens-shed-finder.name: US Men's Shed Association shed finder
us-mens-shed-finder.outcome: Nonprofit with a Find a Shed directory and a guide to starting a new shed
us-mens-shed-finder.limits: No US count on the page; the site footer carried unrelated ad links.
us-mens-shed-finder.locator: "a workshop and social club where men gather to build things"

surgeon-general-advisory.name: US Surgeon General advisory on loneliness and isolation
surgeon-general-advisory.outcome: About one in two US adults reported loneliness even before the pandemic; lacking connection compared to daily smoking for early death risk
surgeon-general-advisory.limits: Opened on a federal summary page; the HHS press release blocked automated access.
surgeon-general-advisory.locator: "About one in two adults in America already reported experiencing loneliness"

holt-lunstad-review.name: Holt-Lunstad review of social relationships and survival
holt-lunstad-review.outcome: 148 studies, 308,849 people; stronger social relationships linked to 50% higher likelihood of survival
holt-lunstad-review.limits: Observational studies pooled; shows association, not that any one change will extend a life.

harvard-adult-development.name: Harvard Study of Adult Development
harvard-adult-development.outcome: Followed 268 sophomores from 1938; close relationships predicted lasting health and happiness more than money or fame
harvard-adult-development.limits: Original group was all men from one college; findings reported in a 2017 university news story.
harvard-adult-development.locator: "Close relationships, more than money or fame, are what keep people happy"

lifeline-988.name: 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline
lifeline-988.outcome: Free, confidential call, text or chat, 24/7, including for emotional distress or needing someone to talk to
lifeline-988.limits: US only; chat and text can have waits, and calling is the fastest route in an emergency.

friendship-line.name: Institute on Aging Friendship Line
friendship-line.outcome: 24/7 line at 888-670-1360 for adults 60 and older, adults with disabilities and caregivers, with optional regular check-in calls
friendship-line.limits: For older adults, people with disabilities and caregivers, not everyone.
friendship-line.locator: "Ongoing outreach calls to individuals who request regular check-ins"

eldercare-locator.name: Eldercare Locator
eldercare-locator.outcome: Federal service at 1-800-677-1116 that finds local programs for older adults, including Area Agencies on Aging and meals
eldercare-locator.limits: Built for older adults and their families.
eldercare-locator.locator: "Find help in your community by entering a location"

help-211.name: 211 helpline network
help-211.outcome: Local 211 services made more than 19 million referrals to help in 2025
help-211.limits: Run by regional organizations, so what's on offer varies by area.
help-211.locator: "211 connects you to expert, caring help"

three-question-scale.name: Three-item loneliness scale (Hughes and colleagues)
three-question-scale.place: Health and Retirement Study, United States
three-question-scale.outcome: Three questions, scored 3 to 9, developed for the 2002 national Health and Retirement Study
three-question-scale.limits: A research measure, not a diagnosis; tested on older adults.

timeleft-dinners.name: Timeleft dinners with strangers
timeleft-dinners.outcome: Weekly dinners matching people into tables with five new faces, in 52 countries
timeleft-dinners.limits: Paid commercial service; figures are from the company's own site.
timeleft-dinners.locator: "The weekly gatherings turning strangers into friends."

buy-nothing.name: Buy Nothing Project
buy-nothing.outcome: More than 14 million members giving each other goods and services among neighbors
buy-nothing.limits: Member count from the project's own page; groups mostly run on Facebook or the app.
buy-nothing.locator: "connects neighbors to gift each other goods and services freely"

resistbot.name: Resistbot
resistbot.outcome: Text-to-letter service for writing elected officials; site reports more than 40 million letters delivered
resistbot.limits: Delivery counts are self-reported and say nothing about responses.
resistbot.locator: "Write to Your Elected Officials in Minutes"
